title: Separate blob retries from deployment creation; prepare API alternative
summary: Reviewed unmodified CLI retry paths, tested synthetic failures and prepared a filtered payload draft. No upload, deployment or verifier rerun. Execution remains gated.

changes.detail: Clarified that five retries apply to content-hashed blob uploads, not a creation retry loop. CLI normally probes creation for missing_files then submits after uploads. No universal provider idempotency guarantee found.
Added four loopback tests of unmodified CLI behavior and five injected-transport fail-closed tests; draft 1204-file payload excludes unrelated files and test artifacts without changing candidate.
Recorded alias limitation, options comparison, durable journal/recovery procedure and required approval changes.

validation.name: CLI local failure cases
validation.detail: Four scenarios: cached success, missing files with one upload retry, lost creation response, creation HTTP 500. Loopback only; no external requests or real credentials.

validation.name: Retry-free state machine
validation.detail: Five scenarios; no retries, at most one creation call, all re-entry blocked. Inert injected transport; no live adapter certified.

validation.name: Candidate and payload
validation.detail: 2601 baseline hashes unchanged, 137 tracked and 15 untracked files preserved. Draft includes all nine untracked runtime files, excludes five tests and verifier CLI; zero selected secret-pattern matches. Pattern coverage is not exhaustive.

validation.name: Release readiness
validation.detail: Filtered package build, live adapter and current provider preflight remain required. Generated Preview aliases cannot be guaranteed absent; explicit approval condition must resolve this. No deployment/acceptance or provider changes.
